text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tunisia's all items consumer price index rose 4,1 percent during the first eight months of 1996.
- President receives trade union leader Ismail Sahbani.
- President chairs cabinet meeting on foreign trade.
- End of prime minister's visit to Morocco. Joint commission meeting on bilateral cooperation to be held in November in Rabat.
- Tourism and handicrafts minister says crisis in tourism in the Mediterranean countries not affecting Tunisia.
